Team —

Quick regional rollup ahead of next week: finance asked for a reconciled view of all EMEA/APAC opportunities that are in "Commit" and "Best Case" by COB Mon (Aug 9 UTC) so we can finalize the August forecast. I attached a working delta sheet (EMEA_pipeline_delta_v2.xlsx) with my notes. Please do the following: 

- Update Stage to one of: Closed, Commit (firm), Forecast (best case), OPP-At-Risk.
- Put an expected close date if it’s moved out of Aug.
- For any deal >$100k ARR, add a 1-line rationale in column H and tag owner.
- If you disagree with my classification, reply in-line and mark the cell comment with your initials.

A few guiding principles: we need the forecast to reflect deals we will reasonably get (firm commit only in the Commit bucket). Anything contingent on legal/discount approval should be Forecast/At-Risk unless you have verbal exec confirmation.

Ben
